payload.core_mechanism_summary: Check if a log of length m can be split into equal integer parts ≥k. If not, Marsel wins. Otherwise, Timur wins iff n is odd.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a simple divisor check, not DP. However, the candidate families only include dynamic programming. dp_1d_state is the least mismatched as the problem could be framed as a 1D state (log length) game, but no state table is built.
